cell_id_forms.round3_appendix: m3-x-<variant>-<regime>-h<sync_ms>-s<seed> where variant is temp<ms> (queue_softmin temperature) or sticky<ms> (queue_greedy_sticky hold); the policy itself is read from the resolved config
cell_id_forms.run_series: family|series|regime|policy|h<sync>; series is 'sync' for the Round-3 matrix, 'default' for Round-2 default cells and 'appendix:<variant>' for parameter sweeps, so runs that share a label but not a contract never get averaged

known_limitations: flip is a truth-substituted re-ranking of the same decision row, not a re-simulated counterfactual
the evaluable subset requires the chosen candidate to carry a truth row; terminal (downlink-exit) candidates never do, so ~0.3% of multi-candidate decisions drop out
truth is sampled only at the candidate target instant; W and the near-tie proxy are decision-level quantities, not packet timings
response-sensitivity columns are behavioural proxies (switch, run length, flip, entropy, near-tie fraction), not a mathematical sensitivity
Gamma needs >=3 truth samples inside +-0.25 s on both resources; sparse probe coverage reduces n
Round-2 sync cells changed advertise_interval_s AND packet_bits/vis_k together, so that sync axis is a combined control-budget axis; policy_params exposes the full control config
paired E2E only aligns packets delivered in BOTH cells; losses show up in PDR/fate counts, not in the delta
the analyzer is read-only over the evidence and cannot see counterfactual fates

available: Gamma bins with flip rates; flip vs tau and vs margin bins
flip rule-relative and truth-argmin; proxy regret distribution
switch rate, same-direction run length, W per flip decision
E2E mean/p50/p95/p99, PDR, throughput, hops, isl_data area
control offered/delivered bits, counters, ctrl_isl_s share
paired E2E across policies sharing source_trace_sha256
sync-axis deltas (slow vs fast advertisement interval)
config sha256, state_policy params, coverage counters
not_available_in_round2_evidence: action entropy: only queue_softmin audits expose probabilities
sticky keep/override: only queue_greedy_sticky audits expose them
path stretch: no shortest-path baseline (hops only)
window-summed control service time: link_service_windows carry no kind=='ctrl' marker (occupied.ctrl_isl_s / stop_time used)
control packet delay: control.instances[3] is an absolute received_at, so advertisement age comes from the probe

purpose: Round-2 regression + schema smoke for sq_round3_analyze.py before Round-3 (m3-*/sq5-*) evidence exists

W_p50_ms.reason: Round-2 emitted ONE sample per flip RUN; Round-3 follows the frozen definition with one sample per FLIP decision, so long flip runs dominate the per-flip median

flip_rate.reason: Round-2 divided flips by ALL multi-candidate rows; Round-3 divides by the evaluable subset (chosen itself truth-labelled) and reports both counts.

hops_mean.reason: Round-2 counted len(path); Round-3 counts edges (len(path)-1), so Round-3 is exactly 1 smaller

margin_used_p50_ms.reason: same quantity on the evaluable subset

switch_rate.reason: streams built from the evaluable subset

m3-c2-geometry-h1000-s8.seed_note: cell-id seed 8 != config scenario.seed 7 (the replicate seed lives in trace_program.seed in this contract)

m3-c2-geometry-h1000-s9.seed_note: cell-id seed 9 != config scenario.seed 7 (the replicate seed lives in trace_program.seed in this contract)

identity_checks.note: empty lists mean seed replicates are independent (distinct traces) and one seed maps to exactly one trace; shared config identity is only a defect when the cells are meant to differ

round3_early_validation.note: first 4 pulled sq5-* m3 cells (geometry s7/s8/s9, queue_greedy s7), analysed with this script while Round-3 was still being produced; the Lead's pipeline owns round3-results/matrix.{json,md}

runtime.determinism: sequential and --jobs 4 produce byte-identical JSON and MD (jobs is an execution knob, not a report parameter)

synthetic_policy_paths.note: synthetic /tmp fixture (not evidence) covering code paths the Round-2 evidence cannot: softmin resampling with the recorded uniform, sticky keep/override, geometry zero-flip control, and the legacy scorer fallback when no state_policy block exists
